messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (preproc/template-engine). Automatic page to on-call. Collecting traces and allocating incident channel.

sara: oncall here — joining. Pulling traces and recent deploys. Anyone else seeing elevated preproc CPU or OOM restarts?

michael: yep. preproc pods in us-east-1 show high RSS and frequent restarts for preproc-7 and preproc-2. Kube events show OOMKilled several times over the past 18m. Queue latency spiking.

anya: traces show template_render span dominating tail: template_render ~400ms median, p95=760ms, p99=1.9s. The expensive step is schema_walk + tool-schema compile in JSON mode. Lots of cache churn.

sara: can we flip JSON-mode off for affected routes while we triage? Also try scaling preproc replicas and force-restart the OOMing ones.

ops-bot: command executed by sara: `kubectl scale deploy preproc -n production --replicas=9` -> OK

michael: scaled. Restarted preproc-2: `kubectl delete pod preproc-2 -n production` -> recreating.

sara: applying route patch to disable json_mode for gen-route-us-east: `PATCH /config/routes/gen-route-us-east {"json_mode": false}`

ops-bot: config update applied. gen-route-us-east json_mode=false

kevin: CS reported several customers with slow streaming responses and one timeout. Sending interim status: what should I tell them?

sara: short customer status: We observed a template rendering regression tied to large tool schemas under JSON-mode, causing p99 latency spikes and streaming stalls. We've disabled JSON-mode for affected routes and scaled preproc; metrics are improving. ETA for full fix: 3 hours (patch + canary + rollout). Will provide updates.

anya: digging into cache behavior — the compiled-schema cache TTL seems to have been reduced in a recent refactor. We're seeing repeated recompile of the same big schemas. Patch ready to restore larger LRU cache with size bounds. Putting PR up now.

michael: logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T17:51:02Z preproc WARN template: compiled schema miss id=0x3fae
2026-03-15T17:51:02Z preproc INFO render step=walk_schema nodes=980 time_ms=372
2026-03-15T17:51:03Z preproc CRIT memory: rss=1.85GB limit=2.0GB
```

sara: good catch. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) keep json_mode disabled for 1h, 2) deploy cache patch to canary in us-east-1 only, 3) monitor p95/p99 and streaming_stall_count for 30m, 4) if stable, roll to region and re-enable json_mode.

ops-bot: PR merged to feature/cached-schema-fix. Canary deploy started to preproc-canary namespace.

anya: canary metrics: compiled-schema cache hit% improved from 12% -> 78% for canary traffic, template p99 down from 1.9s -> 420ms. Streaming stall rate dropped significantly.

devon: i'm coming onshift in ~20m. Please leave a handoff note with current toggles and watchlist.

sara: handoff for @devon: state=mitigated (routing change + scale applied), canary deployed with cache patch, watch metrics: p99 template render, streaming_stall_rate, preproc OOMs, kv-cache hit rate. If regression happens, switch affected routes to fallback-builder and escalate. I'll remain reachable during canary validation.

kevin: sending customer update now and marking tickets with workaround. They're asking about root cause — can we confirm it's compiled-schema cache TTL regression from refactor?

anya: tentative RCA: refactor reduced in-memory retention for compiled tool schemas, increasing recompile cost for large nested schemas in JSON-mode. That caused CPU/memory pressure and tail latency; OOM churn worsened the tail.

ops-bot: alert status: p99 SLO now under threshold for 10m. Snoozing automated alert for 45m.

sara: filing follow-up: creating incident doc and assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime for full RCA and longer-term fixes (schema streaming, incremental compile, fallback render path). Tags: preproc, json-mode, template-render, compiled-schema-cache.

devon: ack. I'll monitor through the end of my shift and post a short summary when I sign off.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status=mitigated, severity=SEV3, brief="Template-render tail latency due to compiled-schema cache regression in JSON-mode causing streaming stalls". Pager closed. Please file postmortem if customer impact > 1h.

kevin: nice work everyone. I'll follow up if customers need more info :thumbsup:
